column3: Attacking Humen is correct. The firewood answer retains a military verb but changes the object; the redundant 进攻伐 preserves the sense only.
The reference explains the succession and the charge of encouraging disorder.
Only the rendering about inheriting the past and illuminating the world conveys the parallel phrases.
Shouchun and Jiankang/Jianye stand in a distance relation. Departure reverses the reading.
The compact answer retains the amazement but leaves the classical wording partially unmodernized.
Pronouns can preserve the unspecified object of Gao Qi's request to attack. The wood passage changes the event.
Felling Qiyuan bamboo for over a million arrows is explicit. The clipped 百多万 phrase reads awkwardly.
The relation is distance of around six li. Repeating 讲堂 or 约 damages the answer.
The negative and both tree species survive in the modern felling answer.
The formal appointment survives only with the proper official and office.
Several options retain a military attack on Zheng but lose the return from the campaign.
Felling for fuel is the complete proposition. 认为 misreads the purpose clause.
Recommendation, death and the correct official survive together in one option.
The departure is followed by resettlement below Mount Qi; several alternatives move the departure to Mount Qi or lose settlement.
The axe is used to fell the tree. Attacking someone changes the sense and 砍伐他 leaves an inappropriate object.
The question asks whether earlier political achievements could recur under the addressee's rule.
The emperor personally attacks us, last year. Omitting us or introducing distance corrupts those details.
The question asks how one could leave. Several options preserve only the departure.
The source limits what he said. The first-person answer changes the speaker.
An attack upon us is predicted. A generic hit is insufficient to identify the military event.
The speaker has been away from home for years. The matched final distance example has no departure gloss.
The minister can therefore leave. Compact modern wording retains the permission.
The officials tour the prefectures, inspect customs and report unlawful acts.
Fell trees to make a defensive barrier. The short 鹿角 answer leaves that use opaque.
Love of home motivates the refusal to leave. The doubled 肯 mars the answer; distance changes the sense.
The phrase describes distance from the bodhisattva. Explicit movement away loses the comparison.
The distance from Sui is over thirty li. Distance alone loses the endpoint; departure does not express the designated sense.
Cutting down woodland is the intended event. Repetition or the unchanged compact clause does not expand the predicate.
Going to fell trees in the Taihang mountains is explicit. 伐木 is also an ordinary modern compound when the surrounding wording is modernized.
The government metaphor concerns the ease of ruling with compassion.
The intended relation is distance from the central plains. Several alternatives confuse 中夏 with summertime.
The offices survive in several answers, but the accession or the appointment is garbled. The reference inserts 乾 in the office title.
Pan Chong attacks Jun again. Duplicating glyphs or changing the object loses complete credit.
The colloquial threat to put out the fire with urine is lost when 溺 becomes death or drowning.
Departure is clear in several options, but only one conveys the dissatisfied manner without spurious agreement or speech.
The complete modern question about attaining longevity retains the named person and the imperial audience.
The Tang realm is seven thousand li from us. Explicit distance with ungrammatical wording is partial.
The removal from office and absence of promotion are both required.
Felling is correct, but the negative condition concerns starting at the root.
Calling up the various forces to attack Song is preserved. Doubling the first character spoils the modern answer.
The attack on Song follows seizure of the duke. Retaining classical 执 without explaining the seizure gives partial credit.
The point is temporal proximity of the Song and the speaker's dynasty, not departure.
